items.sentence: New discoveries constantly force scientists who study archaeology to rethink the dating given to major developments in human prehistory and argue about the dates that human life began and changed.
items.explanation: who study archaeology가 목적어 scientists를 수식합니다.

items.sentence: New discoveries constantly force scientists who study archaeology to rethink the dating given to major developments in human prehistory and argue about the dates that human life began and changed.
items.prompt: force의 목적격보어에서 병렬을 이루는 두 동사구의 중심을 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: force + 목적어 + to부정사 구조이며, to rethink와 (to가 생략된) argue가 and로 병렬 연결됩니다.
items.memory: force O to V, 그리고 병렬에서는 두 번째 to가 생략될 수 있음

items.sentence: Social interaction requires numerous talents and abilities, including the ability to let participants in a social group know the intentions and beliefs of others.
items.prompt: let의 목적격보어 역할을 하는 동사원형을 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 사역동사 let은 목적어 뒤에 동사원형 목적격보어를 취하므로 know가 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: Some people might find getting up early, especially at the weekend, a strange decision, but regardless of what decision is taken I find having choice and control in your life essential for personal well-being and general health.
answers: essential for personal well-being and general health
items.explanation: 첫 find의 목적어는 getting up early, 목적격보어는 a strange decision입니다. 두 번째 find의 목적어는 having choice and control in your life, 목적격보어는 essential ... health입니다.

items.sentence: But regardless of what decision is taken, I find having choice and control in your life essential for personal well-being and general health.
items.prompt: regardless of what decision is taken의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: regardless of는 ‘~에 상관없이’라는 뜻이며, 뒤의 의문사절 what decision is taken 전체가 전치사 of의 목적어입니다.
